name: OmniDocBench
intro: OmniDocBench 是面向多样 PDF 文档解析的细粒度基准。论文 v2 构建了 981 页、九类文档来源、19 类版面元素与 15 个属性标签的评测集；当前官方 v1.7 快照已扩展到 1,651 页、十类来源、28 类块级与四类行内元素标签。
build_method: 论文 v2：20 万+ PDF 视觉聚类、6,000 页候选、属性平衡至 981 页、智能预标注、逐字符人工修订与三人专家质检；当前发布另含 v1.7 扩展
metric: 论文 v2：文本/阅读顺序 NED、表格 TEDS/NED、公式 CDM/NED/BLEU；当前 v1.7 另含 METEOR、COCODet 与 Overall 均值
openness: partly public, research-only dataset; Apache-2.0 code
modality: 文本, 图像, 文档
language: 英文, 中文, 多语言
task_type: 文档解析, OCR, 版面分析
eval_feature: 端到端评测, 逐任务评测, 逐属性评测
scale: 论文 v2：981页、9类文档来源、19类版面元素、15个属性标签、10万+标注；当前HF v1.7：1,651页、10类来源、28类块级+4类行内元素、14类页面/文本/表格属性
openness_en: Partly public, research-only dataset; Apache-2.0 code
build_method_en: Paper v2: visual clustering of 200K+ PDFs, 6,000 candidates, attribute balancing to 981 pages, intelligent pre-annotation, character-level human revision, and three-researcher quality control; the current release separately adds the v1.7 expansion
eval_feature_en: End-to-end Evaluation, Task-level Evaluation, Attribute-level Evaluation
intro_en: OmniDocBench is a fine-grained benchmark for diverse PDF document parsing. Paper v2 constructs a 981-page evaluation set across nine document sources with 19 layout categories and 15 attribute labels; the current official v1.7 snapshot expands this to 1,651 pages, ten sources, 28 block-level and four span-level element labels.
scale_en: Paper v2: 981 pages, 9 document sources, 19 layout categories, 15 attribute labels, 100K+ annotations; current HF v1.7: 1,651 pages, 10 sources, 28 block + 4 span elements, 14 page/text/table attributes
metric_en: Paper v2: text/reading-order NED, table TEDS/NED, formula CDM/NED/BLEU; current v1.7 also supports METEOR, COCODet, and an Overall mean

drawio_review_note: source_stage=paper-alignment; reviewed_at=2026-07-22; benchmark=OmniDocBench. Primary paper evidence is arXiv:2412.07626v2 at https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.07626v2 and https://arxiv.org/pdf/2412.07626v2; the downloaded PDF SHA-256 is 2160acf355867ecdcec5e2d0253f8dd55979b158d9b2ca07089442500e49e562. The paper-v2 construction contract is kept distinct from later releases: collect more than 200,000 PDFs from Common Crawl, Google, Baidu, and internal data; extract ResNet-50 page features; cluster with Faiss into ten centers; sample 6,000 visually diverse candidate pages; label page type, layout type, and language type; then balance to 981 pages spanning nine document sources. Annotation is also paper-bound: fine-tuned LayoutLMv3 supplies layout pre-annotations, PaddleOCR text, UniMERNet formulae, and GPT-4o tables. Annotators refine boxes, reading order, affiliation links, cross-page relationships, Unicode text, LaTeX formulae, and HTML/LaTeX tables, checking each character and using Tables Generator and latexlive where needed. CDM rendering finds unrenderable formula/table content and three researchers review and correct the results. Paper-v2 scale is 981 pages, nine sources, 19 layout categories and 15 attribute labels. Its statistics describe more than 20,000 block annotations across 15 block categories, more than 70,000 span annotations across four span categories, and more than 16,000 reading-order annotations; these categories and relations support the paper summary of more than 100,000 annotations. Paper-v2 evaluation consumes whole-page Markdown, removes images and leading Markdown tags, extracts LaTeX tables, HTML tables, display formulae, Markdown tables and code, segments residual text, then performs adjacency and normalized-edit matching followed by fuzzy subset/merge matching. Ignore logic allows headers, footers, page numbers, page footnotes, and ambiguous captions to participate in matching while excluding them from affected metric calculations. Paper metrics are text and reading-order normalized edit distance, table TEDS and NED, and formula CDM, NED and BLEU, reported overall and by task/page attribute. Official Git revisions are fixed separately: the paper-era v1_0 branch is 337cc26965893db3ef53ddc119a6d6bb5bde096f, while current main is 2b161d010d2e3aff77a0edef359ea3a6411d23cd. The current-main README SHA-256 is 6a062fb1681743356aaf258b925765a8aabddfa834feee09854f2635a12b6f12 and LICENSE SHA-256 is c71d239df91726fc519c6eb72d318ec65820627232b2f796219e87dcf35d0ab4. Current main identifies v1.7 and differs materially from the paper: 1,651 pages across ten data sources, five layout types and five language types; 28 block-level plus four span-level element labels; and 5 page, 3 text, and 6 table attribute tags. It adds 296 difficult pages after the 1,355-row v1.5 pool, adopts Multi-Granularity Adaptive Matching that changes prediction-side segmentation while keeping ground truth fixed, rewrites CDM deployment, supports layout/formula detection through COCODet, adds METEOR, and defines Overall as the mean of text accuracy, table TEDS, and formula CDM. The official Hugging Face snapshot is opendatalab/OmniDocBench revision aa1ee96d106dbe53d0ae59474d75c6e6d9b53fec. Its OmniDocBench.json is 42,208,096 bytes with SHA-256 a45cd84b04ad8b793e775089640e6b681209abea33ead54c1828ddca35fae496. It was downloaded and independently counted as 1,651 records: subset labels are 1,355 v1.5, 100 equation_hard, 99 layout_hard, and 97 table_hard; the ten data_source values total the same 1,651 records. The HF README SHA-256 is 9ac999a6615ae74009c997c4ddc8a72c52423c2b0384235b4126bdc213576e81. Openness is intentionally not flattened to public. The Git code carries Apache License 2.0, while the official dataset copyright statement says research purposes only and not for commercial use. The diagram therefore uses a dashed openness boundary and the detail label says partly public, research-only dataset; Apache-2.0 code. The English source contains no Han characters, the Chinese source preserves equivalent semantics and identical positioned topology, every secondary evidence/drift edge is explicitly dashed, and Mermaid fallbacks are regenerated exactly from the source specs. Formal .drawio, .arch.json, .svg, and .png assets were intentionally not modified in this source-stage pass. Formal publication evidence [site-a12a-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3845×905 (English) and 3845×905 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3843×903 and 3843×903. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
